verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Devin's docs describe taking over in Devin's IDE once it produces a good first draft (devin-docs-5), which suggests you can inspect changes before finalizing them. Devin Review with Auto-Fix (devin-docs-20) operates on code review comments and CI after a PR exists, not as a pre-PR gate. Missing for 10: an explicit diff-review view of agent changes, an approval step that gates PR creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of such a workflow.
